Seeded from data/bs_source: WEAPONS (names/colours), AMMO_BASE + AMMO_PER_TIER (index.html:4415), W_BASE_DMG (12162), OMEGA_DESC (4421), UPG_TRACKS (mods), SHOP_TRADE_VALUE; fire functions fireBlaster 4552, fireBoomBox 4574, detonateRave 4614, releaseRipper 4729, fireZap 4783, updateWeapons 5175, implodeAt/explodeAt 5212, updateProjectiles 5341, WHEEL 17779. lines._doc: New player-facing lines owned by the weapons builder (VOManager's index doesn't carry them yet; WeaponText falls back to these).

bs.weapon.levelup.01.text: Your gun leveled up. It's growing. I'm not crying, you're crying.

bs.weapon.levelup.02.text: V3! It's learned a trick. I'd say it was me who taught it, but it wasn't.

bs.weapon.levelup.03.text: V5. That thing has seen more combat than most generals. Blartz will want to touch it.

bs.weapon.levelup.04.text: Level up. The weapon is improving. The wielder remains a work in progress.

bs.weapon.zap.amp.01.text: Oh, so I'm a PYLON now. Great. Really living the dream.

bs.weapon.zap.amp.02.text: Standing still in a firefight. This is a choice. This is YOUR choice.

bs.weapon.zap.amp.03.text: My capacitors are filing a grievance. With me. About you.

bs.weapon.zap.amp.04.text: Fine! FINE! UNLIMITED POWER! Or, you know, about twelve volts more than usual.

bs.weapon.zap.amp.05.text: Can I move now? I'm moving. I'm moving now.

bs.weapon.hint.heat.text: OVERHEAT! Let the Omni-Blaster vent, or cash the heat in with a HOT ROUND (alt-fire).

bs.weapon.hint.hot_round_cold.text: Hot Round needs at least 25 heat. Spray first, then cash it in.

bs.weapon.hint.rift_cd.text: The Rift is still stitching itself shut.

bs.weapon.unlock.scrapheap_clear.text: Blartz stocks this once Scrapheap is cleared.

bs.weapon.unlock.first_core.text: Blartz stocks this after your first Keystone Core.

bs.weapon.unlock.nova.text: Blartz stocks this on Nova Plaza.

bs.weapon.unlock.nova_core.text: Blartz stocks this after the Nova Plaza core.

bs.weapon.unlock.glacius_core.text: Blartz stocks this after the Glacius Vault core.

bs.weapon.unlock.verdant.text: Blartz stocks this on Verdant Sink.

bs.weapon.unlock.verdant_core.text: Blartz stocks this after the Verdant Sink core.

bs.weapon.unlock.galleria.text: Blartz stocks this at the Grand Galleria.

bs.weapon.unlock.blartz_gift.text: A gift. From someone who is still in a cell.

lines._m3: M3 lines (Builder A): popups, hints, new ad vignettes (BS_WEAPONS §9), Middleman / Hostile Takeover barks (§11).

bs.weapon.hint.buzz_empty.text: Out of saw blades. Blartz has more. Blartz always has more.

bs.weapon.hint.frost_empty.text: Out of coolant. The Frostbyte is now a strongly worded fan.

bs.weapon.hint.latefee_empty.text: Out of shells. Collections will be in touch.

bs.weapon.hint.fineprint_empty.text: Out of rounds. Please see the terms regarding refills.

bs.weapon.hint.hostile_empty.text: Out of contracts. Legal is drafting more.

bs.weapon.hint.clearance_empty.text: Out of price tags. Everything already went.

bs.weapon.hint.class_cd.text: The class action is still gathering plaintiffs.

bs.weapon.hint.ice_wall_cd.text: The ice wall needs a moment to set.

bs.weapon.hint.replant_cd.text: The garden is still settling in.

bs.weapon.hint.doorbuster.text: Spin the barrels up for a second first, then release alt-fire for a DOORBUSTER.

bs.weapon.hint.read_scope.text: READ CAREFULLY works while scoped. Aim first.

bs.weapon.hint.hostile_full.text: Two subsidiaries is the legal maximum. The antitrust people are watching.

bs.weapon.hint.merger.text: A MERGER needs a subsidiary in your sights and another within 8 m.

bs.weapon.hint.paint.text: Hold alt-fire and sweep across up to 3 targets to PAINT them, then fire a volley.

bs.ad.latefee.01.text: Book club running LATE? Neighbour still hasn't returned your casserole dish? Introducing the LATE FEE!

bs.ad.latefee.02.text: The longer you DON'T pull the trigger, the more it hurts when you DO. That's not a weapon. That's a financial instrument!

bs.ad.latefee.03.text: So it rewards you for not shooting. You're selling us patience.

bs.ad.latefee.04.text: I'm selling you INTEREST. Patience is free, and I don't stock free things.

bs.ad.latefee.05.text: And if they run? COLLECTIONS. One little tug and they're back in your life, where they belong.

bs.ad.latefee.06.text: Late Fee™ interest compounds per second. Rates may change without notice. Notice may change without rates. Past-due accounts will be pursued across state lines, star systems and the afterlife.

bs.ad.fineprint.01.text: Signing a lease at the family reunion? Don't sign ANYTHING until you've read... THE FINE PRINT!

bs.ad.fineprint.02.text: Every bullet is a tiny paragraph of tiny text. It finds the weak point, it highlights the weak point, and then everybody else gets to read it too!

bs.ad.fineprint.03.text: A gun that makes people read the terms. That's the cruellest thing you've ever built.

bs.ad.fineprint.04.text: And with READ CAREFULLY, time slows down so you can really take it all in. Nobody has ever done that. Not once. In history.

bs.ad.fineprint.05.text: The Fine Print™ is subject to the following terms: [THE NEXT FOUR SECONDS OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT ARE PLAYED AT SIX TIMES SPEED]

bs.ad.fineprint.07.text: Nobody ever does. That's the beauty of it.

bs.ad.hostile.01.text: Is the neighbour's lemonade stand doing better than yours? Don't compete — ACQUIRE!

bs.ad.hostile.02.text: HOSTILE TAKEOVER! One beam, one signature, and that goon who was trying to kill you is now a valued member of YOUR team!

bs.ad.hostile.04.text: Ten seconds! Which is longer than most corporate mergers, and FAR more honest.

bs.ad.hostile.05.text: And when the ten seconds are up?

bs.ad.hostile.06.text: Then they're LET GO. It's nothing personal. It's restructuring.

bs.ad.hostile.07.text: Hostile Takeover™ does not work on bosses, unions, or anyone with a good lawyer. Subsidiaries are not entitled to benefits, severance, or an explanation.

bs.ad.clearance.01.text: Darlings, it's the garage sale of the CENTURY and EVERYTHING must go!

bs.ad.clearance.02.text: Introducing the CLEARANCE RACK! Six spinning barrels of price-tag rounds. Every tag marks down your enemy's armour. Ten percent! Twenty! FIFTY PERCENT OFF!

bs.ad.clearance.03.text: What happens at a hundred percent off?

bs.ad.clearance.04.text: Nobody knows! No customer has ever survived long enough to check out!

bs.ad.clearance.05.text: And for the early birds: the DOORBUSTER. Clears a path to the deals. And through the people standing near the deals.

bs.ad.clearance.06.text: All sales final. No returns, exchanges, or survivors. Clearance Rack™ is not responsible for trampling, stampedes, or what happens on Black Friday. Price-tag rounds may not be combined with other offers.

bs.weapon.middleman.argue.01b.text: You took the big one LAST time.

bs.weapon.middleman.argue.02.text: Per my last ping, that kill was mine.

bs.weapon.middleman.argue.03.text: Let's circle back on who's aiming where.

bs.weapon.middleman.argue.04.text: I'm escalating this to the guy holding the gun.

bs.weapon.middleman.argue.06.text: They're arguing about KPIs mid-gunfight. I've never felt more at home.
